_meta.coder_A_EP_rule: Coder-A operational rule for EP in this area: EP=1 only when the paper reports that the already-trained model was applied to a batch of physical samples/measurements produced or collected separately from the model-development dataset, with a quantitative comparison of model output against measurements/ground truth for that batch, framed as a test/validation. Random hold-out or CV splits of one collected dataset, and purely in-silico verification, are EP=0. (Protocol section 7 routes 'a separately collected batch from the same lab and set-up' to EP rather than E1.)
